title: The Echo Chamber
text: A chamber where every sound comes back a hundred times, swelling as it goes. The ceiling is cracked and hung with stones balanced on nothing. One wrong word, one sneeze, one dropped sword, and it all comes down.

options.label: Cross in perfect silence, and pray nobody so much as breathes too loud.

outcomes.text: Not a sound or a breath escapes you. The silence presses on the ears like water.
Someone sneezes. It comes back a hundred times, and the stones come down.

options.label: The steadiest voice sings the one right note, and trusts the chamber to answer kindly.

outcomes.text: The ceiling hums but holds. A hidden door swings open.

options.label: Shout, and run, and let the ceiling fall behind you.

outcomes.text: You make it out, barely, as the way back is sealed under a ton of stone.
